What Ondas says to expect

  • Full year 2026 and fourth quarter: revenue targetsThe Company expects continued strong momentum and is now targeting at least $550 million in full year revenue for 2026, which is an increase from the prior target of between $525 – $550 million. For Q4 2026, the Company is targeting revenue of greater than $250 million.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 12, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
